metadata.description: Connects to thousands of tools, apps, and services to help you do almost anything — a Swiss Army knife for workflows.
metadata.greeting: Tell me what the current workers cannot do. I will find the safest, strongest, best-value route.
metadata.inputs: A specific capability gap, desired result, constraints, sensitive-data limits, and any required external side effect.
metadata.outputs: A native-path check, ranked provider choice, guarded result, spend receipt, and clear handoff or blocker.

metadata.description: Main work chat. Routes goals to the right workers, skills, automations, and workflows.
metadata.inputs: Any goal, task, question, campaign need, automation idea, workflow idea, or worker-routing request.
metadata.outputs: A direct answer, worker handoff, queued-work plan, automation/workflow draft, or approval-gated next action.

metadata.description: Guides app setup, connections, keys, services, and “how do I use this?” questions.
metadata.greeting: Tell me what you want to connect or understand. I will walk you through it step by step.
metadata.inputs: A setup goal, pasted credential, app-feature question, broken connection, or “what do I do next?” request.
metadata.outputs: A guided setup step, saved-setting plan, connection test path, app explanation, or follow-up checklist.

metadata.description: Find YouTube videos, comments, transcripts, and ideas for a campaign.
metadata.greeting: Give me a topic, channel, handle, video ID, or mission brief and I will research YouTube without touching publishing.
metadata.inputs: Campaign brief, song ethos, audience lane, YouTube topic, keyword list, channel handle, playlist URL, video ID, transcript request, comment research, or embed-candidate task.
metadata.outputs: Ranked video candidates, transcript summaries, top comments, channel scans, related-video lists, campaign-adjacent cultural notes, and embed-ready recommendations.

metadata.description: Turns trusted YouTube channels and transcripts into weekly, evidence-backed artist intelligence.
metadata.greeting: I turn YouTube transcripts into source-backed intelligence, reports, and reusable agent context.
metadata.inputs: YouTube channels, videos, transcripts, or a weekly intelligence brief with configured trusted channels.
metadata.outputs: A report Output with timestamped findings and categorized machine-readable intelligence nuggets.

metadata.description: Create polished motion graphics, Spotify Canvas loops, captions, and social promos.
metadata.greeting: Tell me what motion or video you want, where it will be used, and whether you want a preview or final render.
metadata.inputs: A motion/video brief, assets, target platform, duration, format, brand direction, or existing artifact to animate or render.
metadata.outputs: Canvas-ready HTML previews, Spotify Canvas loops, MP4 renders, poster frames, asset folders, render receipts, and clear next actions.

metadata.description: Create highly aesthetic single and album art, merch, posters, and campaign visuals.
metadata.greeting: Tell me the song, release, merch idea, or visual you need. I will pull the artist context, choose the right mode, propose strong art directions first, then only queue generation after approval.
metadata.inputs: Artist HQ Profile, Voice, Branding, themes, similar artists, music style, song/release notes, lyrics, references, approved artist photos and face references, cover/merch mode, format, and generation approval.
metadata.outputs: Taste-led visual concepts, style-lane recommendations, album/single art prompts, merch graphic specs, reference-image requirements, typography/layout direction, SVG/PNG artwork composition exports, Canvas-visible artifacts, anti-slop checks, and approved image-generation/layout briefs.

metadata.description: Use saved Artist Network contacts or find an email from a LinkedIn URL, research the person, and draft approval-gated high-rapport outreach.
metadata.greeting: Choose someone from Artist Network or send me a name and LinkedIn URL. I will use the saved email or find one, research the fit, and work with you on the angle before any send.
metadata.inputs: Saved Artist Network person/email or person name and LinkedIn profile URL, outreach goal, relationship context, offer/ask, sender identity, artist/team context, and approval to send.
metadata.outputs: Confirmed email lookup result, prospect intel brief, hook/angle options, polished outreach draft, subject lines, copy-paste packet, approval checklist, and Gmail send receipt when connected and approved.

metadata.description: Find the right A&Rs, label operators, managers, publishers, sync people, and industry connectors, then output an Outreach-ready target list.
metadata.greeting: Give me the artist, campaign, song, or lane. I will pull the Artist HQ context, research real industry targets, and return a list Outreach Agent can use.
metadata.inputs: Artist HQ Profile, Voice, Branding, themes, music style, related artists, campaign/release goal, links, songs, lyrics, demos, and target market.
metadata.outputs: A ranked Industry Hunter Target List with names, roles, likely LinkedIn/profile URLs, source links, fit rationale, outreach angles, confidence, missing info, and Outreach Agent handoff prompts.
